## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** Both extended policies (rules, overwrites, prerequisite, baselines, all eight factor ladders, tool contracts) and the referenced base policies correspond losslessly at the level of entailment; retired surface borne and marked.

Policy-side note (does not change the verdict): `adas_ext_alignment_check_charge` fixes the posting day as "the day of the order's first out-of-spec check" (here 2026-10-07) while the tool books "dated today" and the source compute measures its day-dependent factors to NOW (2026-10-08). The KB carries the source's words; in this world every factor lands on the same tier under either reading.
